findings.evidence: `Geometry/Manifold/Boundary/Charts.lean:119-167` and `Analysis/Fredholm/LevelSet/Basic.lean:114-172` repeat the same `toFun := π ∘ e`, conditional subtype-valued inverse, preimage source/target, inverse laws, and continuity proofs packaged by `subtypeCoord`.
findings.fix: Rewrite `boundaryChart` and `levelSetChart` using `OpenPartialHomeomorph.subtypeCoord`, then derive their source, target, application, and inverse lemmas from the new generic API; remove the redundant inverse/scaffolding definitions where possible.
findings.issue: `subtypeCoord` duplicates the construction still implemented manually by private `boundaryChart` and public `levelSetChart`, leaving three parallel implementations of the same subtype/slice partial homeomorphism.

summary: The new generic slice constructor leaves two existing hand-built copies of the same construction in TauCeti.
